## Network360 Core Team

With this release, the Network360 Core Team is excited to enhance Accessibility by aligning the default options for viewing the analysis results with the user’s selected criteria.  In Compare Networks, we also made performance improvements.   

## Enhancements

#### Accessibility

On the Geographic Summary tab and export, the default option for the Comparison Network filter has been updated.

* If you do not include a comparison network in the analysis criteria, the default option is “None.” 

  * You can choose to select Total Market as the Comparison Network by selecting one of the field’s dropdown options. 
* If you include at least one comparison network within the analysis criteria, the Comparison Network filter’s default option is “Top Networks.”  This displays the results for up to 4 top comparison networks based on the number of comparison networks included in the analysis criteria.

  * If you deselect the “Top Networks” option, you will see other possible selections for this field. 
  * To choose “None”, do not select any other options after deselecting “Top Networks”.

The color on the Access Map has been updated to increase legibility of the chart labels. 



#### Compare Networks

With this release, performance is improved for analyses that use large population files. 

To prevent timeouts when rendering a PDF export, when the selected geography is greater than 16 states, the Network Strength Details results will be grouped by state instead of by county.



## Fixes

#### My Things

Now, when you open the My Things menu on the left sidebar navigation panel, the My Things menu will no longer remain on the screen after you navigate to one of the options within the menu.
